items.title: Why Are Western Digital (WDC) Shares Falling On AI Data Center Policy Risk?
items.summary: Western Digital (NasdaqGS:WDC) shares fell alongside wider US tech on 5 November 2026 after renewed Democratic election momentum. Investors reacted to signals from leading Democrats that large AI data centers could face tighter federal oversight and permitting rules. Policy discussions now include potential caps on new data center projects in key US regions that host hyperscale AI facilities. The prospect of stricter AI data center regulation frames a new policy risk for Western Digital...

items.title: Caterpillar Sinks Another 6%, Vertiv Down 14%, Quanta Down 12% as AI Selloff Spreads to Industrials
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCaterpillar fell 6% today as the AI selloff spread from chip and storage stocks like Western Digital to industrials like Vertiv and Quanta Services. Investors are selling Caterpillar as a data-center stock, though power generation was 15% of its 2025 sales and revenues, and the selling looks overdone.
